# Canary deployment not shifting traffic

A canary release was started but 100% of traffic still hits the stable version.

The Istio control plane failed to push the updated route config to the sidecars, so the canary weight was recorded but never enforced at the data plane.

1. Confirm the rollout set the weight but the mesh did not apply it
2. Restart the istiod control-plane pod to force a config push
3. Verify the VirtualService weights propagate to sidecars
4. Resume the canary and watch real traffic split

Error Details
```
Argo Rollouts: 'canary weight 20% set but 0% observed'; VirtualService weight not applied; istio-proxy config not synced (CDS push failed)
```

Tags: cicd, canary, istio, traffic-shift, argo-rollouts
